seo.title: 7-Day Northern Morocco Tour from Tangier to Marrakech | Chefchaouen & Fes (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €690 pp. 7-day tour from Tangier to Marrakech via Chefchaouen, Roman Volubilis, medieval Fes & High Atlas. Private VIP transport & certified city guides.
seo.lead: A 7-day private cross-country journey from the Mediterranean gateway of Tangier to the vibrant Red City of Marrakech. Traversing northern Morocco and the Middle Atlas, this cultural expedition connects the coastal Kasbah of Tangier, the blue mountain alleys of Chefchaouen, the Roman ruins of Volubilis, the UNESCO medina of Fes, alpine Ifrane, and imperial Marrakech.
seo.primaryKeyword: 7 day northern Morocco tour from Tangier

price.label: From EUR 690 per person
price.note: Price includes private air-conditioned vehicle with dedicated multilingual driver-guide, 6 nights in boutique riads and hotels (Chefchaouen, Fes, Marrakech), official guided walking tours in Fes and Marrakech, entrance coordination, and daily breakfasts.

seo.imageAlt: Sunlit blue medina alley of Chefchaouen on a 7-day northern Morocco expedition from Tangier to Marrakech
highlights: Explore the historic medina, Grand Socco, and Caves of Hercules overlooking the Atlantic in Tangier
Wander through the cobalt-blue painted streets and mountain cafes of Chefchaouen in the Rif Mountains
Marvel at the grand mosaic floors, triumphal arch, and Roman basilica at UNESCO-listed Volubilis
Immerse yourself in Fes el-Bali on a full-day guided walking tour through 1,200 years of artisan history
Drive through the cedar forests of the Middle Atlas, observing native Barbary macaques in the wild
Conclude in Marrakech with a private guided visit to Bahia Palace, Saadian Tombs, and Jemaa el-Fnaa square

faqs.question: Can this tour pick us up from the Tangier ferry port or airport?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your private driver meets you directly at Tangier City Port (arriving by ferry from Tarifa, Spain), Tangier Med Port, Tangier Ibn Battouta Airport (TNG), or your Tangier hotel at your requested time.

faqs.question: Is this 7-day route suitable for travelers arriving from Spain or southern Europe?
faqs.answer: Yes. This itinerary is the premier cross-country route for travelers arriving in northern Morocco, allowing you to experience the Mediterranean north, the Rif Mountains, imperial cities, and Marrakech without redundant travel.

faqs.question: What is the balance between driving time and sightseeing?
faqs.answer: Daily driving stretches average 3 to 4 hours along modern highways and scenic mountain passes, leaving abundant time for afternoon exploration, guided medina walks, relaxed lunches, and photography.

faqs.question: Are certified city guides included in Fes and Marrakech?
faqs.answer: Yes. Official certified local guides are fully included for dedicated half-day walking tours in both Fes and Marrakech to navigate the souks and uncover the rich architectural heritage of each imperial capital.

faqs.question: Can a Sahara desert overnight be integrated into this 7-day trip?
faqs.answer: If you wish to add the Sahara desert (Merzouga or Erg Chebbi), we can customize the route between Fes and Marrakech, or extend the itinerary to 8 or 9 days for an unhurried desert bivouac experience.
